name: sroi_multi_year_dropoff_attribution_basis
question_template: A fund invests {INV} USD million in a job-readiness programme and measures SROI over four years. Year 1 serves {B} thousand beneficiaries; each later year's active count is the prior year's count reduced by {DROP} percent. Each active beneficiary generates {V} USD of outcome value per year. Deadweight of {DW} percent of gross value is removed first. The quoted {ATTR} percent attribution is the share of deadweight-adjusted value attributable to {ATTR_MODE}; if quoted for other_actors, the programme's share is the remainder. Net attributable value is deadweight-adjusted value times the programme's share. SROI equals net attributable value on the {BASIS} basis divided by the investment, both in USD millions: cumulative uses the four-year total, first_year uses year 1 only. Report the SROI ratio.

slots.description: Four-year total gross outcome value before deadweight and attribution, in USD millions
Fraction of deadweight-adjusted value credited to the programme after reading the quote
Year 1 net attributable value in USD millions
Four-year total net attributable value in USD millions

program:
def solve():
    inv = P["INV"]
    b_thousand = P["B"]
    drop = P["DROP"]
    v = P["V"]
    dw = P["DW"]
    attr = P["ATTR"]
    mode = P["ATTR_MODE"]
    basis = P["BASIS"]
    if inv <= 0:
        raise ValueError("investment must be positive")
    if mode == "the_programme":
        share = attr / 100
    elif mode == "other_actors":
        share = 1 - attr / 100
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown attribution mode")
    if share <= 0 or share > 1:
        raise ValueError("programme share must lie in (0, 1]")
    retain = 1 - drop / 100
    if retain < 0:
        raise ValueError("drop-off cannot exceed 100 percent")
    dw_factor = 1 - dw / 100
    count = b_thousand
    gross_years = []
    for t in range(4):
        gross_usd_million = v * count * 1000 / 1000000
        gross_years.append(gross_usd_million)
        count = count * retain
    gross_cum = gross_years[0] + gross_years[1] + gross_years[2] + gross_years[3]
    net_years = [g * dw_factor * share for g in gross_years]
    net_y1 = net_years[0]
    net_cum = net_years[0] + net_years[1] + net_years[2] + net_years[3]
    if basis == "cumulative":
        chosen = net_cum
    elif basis == "first_year":
        chosen = net_y1
    else:
        raise ValueError("unknown basis")
    sroi = chosen / inv
    return {
        "final": sroi,
        "gross_cumulative_value": gross_cum,
        "programme_attribution_share": share,
        "net_first_year_value": net_y1,
        "net_cumulative_value": net_cum,
    }
